highlights_led_by_exploit_ready_vulns: Zoom zero-click RCE flaws allow attackers to compromise meeting participants and Microsoft Patch Tuesday, August 2026 Security Update Review. Treat newly published PoCs and early exploitation signals as immediate patch/mitigation triggers for internet-facing and fleet-wide infrastructure.
endpoint_posture_under_pressure: Fake CCleaner installs GhostDesk Chrome spyware. Tighten EDR coverage, block known IoCs where available, and validate software supply-chain integrity in build and CI/CD.
